high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "beautifuldestinations." The post features a photograph taken in Copenhagen, Denmark, showcasing a series of identical terraced houses arranged in neat rows. The houses have gray roofs and light-colored facades, with some windows open and others closed. The architecture appears uniform, suggesting a planned urban development. The photo is taken from an elevated perspective, providing a bird's-eye view of the houses, which creates a sense of order and symmetry.
